question: 2026年6月各品类的销售额排名
gold_sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(i.subtotal) AS sales FROM fact_order_items i JOIN dim_product p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN fact_orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('已完成','已支付','已退款') AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales DESC

question: 2026年6月华南大区的GMV是多少
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.shop_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('已完成','已支付','已退款') AND s.region = '华南' AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01'

question: 2026年6月各区域的退款率
gold_sql: SELECT s.region AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS refund_rate FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.shop_id LEFT JOIN fact_refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('已完成','已支付','已退款') AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY refund_rate DESC

question: 2026年6月每天的销售趋势
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(o.order_date) AS dt, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_orders o WHERE o.order_status IN ('已完成','已支付','已退款') AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY DATE(o.order_date) ORDER BY dt

question: 金卡会员的客单价是多少
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_order_value FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('已完成','已支付','已退款') AND c.member_level = '金卡会员'

question: 2026年6月销量最高的10个商品
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name AS product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_qty FROM fact_order_items i JOIN dim_product p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN fact_orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('已完成','已支付','已退款') AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 10

question: 各支付方式的订单占比
gold_sql: SELECT pay_method, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_orders WHERE order_status IN ('已完成','已支付','已退款') AND order_date >= '__PSTART__' AND order_date < '__PEND__' GROUP BY pay_method ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: 2026年6月的平均评分和评价数
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(star) AS avg_star, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM fact_reviews WHERE created_at >= '2026-06-01' AND created_at < '2026-07-01'

question: 2026年6月各店铺的销售额TOP5
gold_sql: SELECT s.shop_name AS shop_name, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_shop s ON o.shop_id = s.shop_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('已完成','已支付','已退款') AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY s.shop_name ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 5

question: 2026年6月各会员等级的支付订单数
gold_sql: SELECT c.member_level AS member_level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_customer c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('已完成','已支付','已退款') AND o.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY c.member_level ORDER BY order_count DESC
